market.summary: A weaker open is likely: GIFT Nifty was about 22,644-22,654 before 8:35 IST, roughly 0.4% below the futures' previous close, with Asia lower (Hang Seng about -2.5%, Kospi about -2%, Nikkei about -0.8 to -1%) and US futures slipping after Wall Street's tech-led gain. Brent is above $110 after the US told its diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia. FIIs and DIIs were both net buyers yesterday, and IT should stay supported by the overnight US tech earnings, but small and mid caps start from a four-month low.

points.text: US on 21 Oct: Nasdaq +1.05% to 26,702.86, S&P 500 +0.58% to 7,757.17, Dow +0.69%; earnings (Meta revenue beat, Super Micro guidance) eased worries about AI spending. S&P 500 futures were down about 0.4-0.5% in Asian trade.
Asia this morning: Hang Seng about -2.5%, Kospi about -1.9%, Nikkei -0.4% to -1%; MSCI Asia ex-Japan is heading for a fourth weekly fall.

Brent up about 1.1% to $110, near a five-month high: the US ordered diplomats out of Saudi Arabia after Houthi strikes, and a NYT report said the US and Israel have plans for renewed strikes on Iran after the 3 Nov midterms. The US 10-year yield eased to about 5.11%.
Rupee firmed about 0.5% to 94.46 per dollar on 21 Oct, its strongest since early September, helped by Jio IPO inflows.
NSE provisional flows 21 Oct: FIIs net bought about Rs 1,022 Cr and DIIs about Rs 1,614 Cr.
Results due today include Havells, HPCL, Colgate-Palmolive, Swiggy, Adani Energy Solutions and Adani Total Gas; the Jio Platforms IPO closes on 23 Oct.

market.watch: Whether small caps hold near the 200-day average after yesterday's breakdown, Brent above $110, and IT holding its gains ahead of Infosys results on 23 Oct.

HCLTECH.watch: A close at or above 1,437.78 (+1R) moves the stop to cost; stop 1,225.82; Infosys results on 23 Oct set the sector tone.
